claim: The same OpenEvolve function_minimization task completed a real five-minute run through native OpenEvolve, plain Codex, Goal Plus hosted by Codex, and Goal Plus hosted by Pi.

protocol.credential_policy: OPENAI_API_KEY inherited from the shell; no credential or endpoint is retained in this promoted evidence

canonical_runs.coverage_note: The upstream runner persisted best iteration but not an exact evaluator-call ledger or API usage.

usage.coverage: one of two lanes; the deadline-stopped lane did not emit terminal usage

canonical_runs.coverage_note: The top-level Codex process was stopped at the deadline before emitting terminal usage; durable worker/session state is retained in the ignored raw run.

This raw run exposed a Pi slash-command parsing edge case that created a duplicate goal linked to the same Search run. Idempotent closeout repaired it; the current natural-language resume prompt prevents that duplicate and is regression-tested.

supplementary_validation.purpose: Validate a non-empty Goal Plus promotion, because the final canonical Codex run selected an empty seed patch.
supplementary_validation.note: The direct post-repair native evaluation is validation-only and is not included in the run's original evaluator-call budget.

diagnostic.finding: A separate unprepared Goal Plus Codex run spent nearly the whole 300-second budget on generic intake/spec setup and materialized zero candidates.
diagnostic.decision: Comparable search-stage runs therefore prepare goal, triage, frozen verifier spec, and an empty Search run before T; all candidate creation and model search remain inside T.

telemetry_correction: The raw Goal Plus manifests captured the prepare-time verifier call but not the second seed evaluation immediately before T when labeling setup calls. The promoted counts above correct setup_before_t to 2; the current harness snapshots the controller ledger at T0 and regression tests cover the accounting helper.
interpretation: This is E2E wiring evidence, not a scientific ranking: it covers one task and one seed, evaluator-call and usage coverage differ by upstream runner, and neither Goal Plus host improved over the seed in the canonical run.
